statement: Among infant deaths reviewed by the National Fatality Review Case Reporting System (NFR-CRS), hospitalization for newborn complications before the first birthday is more common among SUID cases compared to non-SUID cases.
rationale: The design uses a case-case comparison within ncfrp_v51 to identify factors specific to SUID, comparing hospitalization history between SUID and other infant deaths. PRAMS provides exposure prevalence for live births but does not serve as a denominator source.
prior_art: None in the inputs; existing literature has not thoroughly investigated the impact of early-life medical issues on later SUID risk.
cannot_establish: incidence rates, risk factors with unmeasured confounding, prevalence of hospitalization in the general population.
